<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): void {
        echo "FALL;";
    }
};
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
$destination = $reader->$selector === null;
echo $destination === true ? "NULL;" : "BAD_NULL;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get($incoming): VOID {
        echo "BARE;";
        $incoming = false;
        return;
    }
};
$selector = "value";
echo $reader->$selector === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD_NULL;";
$reader->other;
echo "DROP;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): never {
        echo "ENTER;";
    }
};
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector === null; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
